verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is a desktop operating system distribution, not a service that exposes an API, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is outside its product category. The evidence covers desktop features, packages, containers and VMs, and nothing shows it ships an API-credential capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
